description: This file defines the PoItem class used for handling translation items in gettext PO files within Drupal, including methods for managing translation data and formatting output.

classes.name: PoItem
classes.description: Class representing a translation item in gettext PO files, with methods for managing translation data, formatting, and output.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the language code of the translation item.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the translation item.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context of the translation.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the context of the translation.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source string(s), possibly with plurals.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source string(s), possibly with plurals.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Returns the translation string(s), possibly with plurals.

methods.name: setTranslation
methods.description: Sets the translation string(s), possibly with plurals.

methods.name: setPlural
methods.description: Indicates whether the translation has plural forms.

methods.name: isPlural
methods.description: Checks if the translation has plural forms.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the translation.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the translation.

methods.name: setFromArray
methods.description: Creates a PoItem from a structured array, parsing plurals if delimiter is present.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Outputs the PoItem as a formatted string.

methods.name: formatItem
methods.description: Formats the PoItem as a string, including context and translation.

methods.name: formatString
methods.description: Prepares a string for multiline PO file output, escaping characters and wrapping lines.
